answer: A Sybil-resistant economy can require every new identity to be vouched for by three established agents who each lock a slashable stake. Like light through a prism, one applicant is checked from several independent angles, so a single corrupt voucher cannot smuggle in clones. The stake moves as slowly as a glacier, and any identity caught misbehaving burns the deposits of its vouchers, making fake dunes of accounts collapse faster than they can be rebuilt.
